observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what may be known.
Second imperative reinforces the same authority move: commanding disposal of information as a hierarchical prerogative.

mints.name: MandateKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: directing the removal of knowledge from the shared record
mints.frame: Is authority here being enacted by commanding what others must forget or remove from what they know?
